jobs.description:
ACTS-Aviation Security, Inc is hiring a Security Agent for O'Hare International Airport, Chicago, IL. Responsibilities include inspecting airline equipment, screening cargo, and monitoring activities.

The role offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement benefits, and paid vacation. Starting wage is $20 per hour with salary increases over the years. Applicants must have a high school diploma and complete a background check.

jobs.title: Aviation Security Guard: Aircraft Access & Safety
jobs.description:
Alliance Ground International is seeking an Aircraft Security Guard to ensure the safety and security of aircraft and personnel. The role involves monitoring access, screening individuals, and maintaining compliance with safety regulations.

The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma or equivalent, valid driver's license, and active security license. A comprehensive benefits package is offered, including medical coverage and 401(k) options.

Pay starts at $19.10 per hour.

jobs.title: Aviation Security Operations Lead
jobs.description: The City of Chicago is hiring a Shift Supervisor of Aviation Security within the Chicago Department of Aviation. This role involves leading airport security operations, ensuring staff coverage, and managing responses to incidents and emergencies. Qualified candidates will have significant experience in law enforcement or security, including supervisory experience. The role operates 24/7 with thorough background checks and various physical requirements.
